notes.title: Small fix update notes for March 15 2023
notes.notes:
A small bug fix update:
- Fixed a possible bug in controller focus in cut scenes.
- Fixed a cache bug when restarting games.

notes.title: Roller Drama Officially Steam Deck Verified! Plus Clear Texts Update
notes.notes:
For this update, we worked on optimizing readability and font quality rendering, which was sub-optimal for Chinese and Japanese fonts.
Now the latter don't rely on fallbacks for missing characters so the overall experience should be better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/05453e8e1809e6c3b918340f4795f1687e375237.jpg

Plus, Roller Drama got a "Steam Deck verified" check! Playing matches on a Steam Deck should be even better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/f00e2ec242f034a869d48e7eb4ecf8da6fd6785f.jpg

Also,  a host of little fixes and improvements:

 Little fix when opening and closing meta panels.
 Clearer icons for selecting and deselecting special actions in matches.
 Fixed order of card selection in matches.
 Fixed a bug when opening the Mental State panel and then attempting to close it with "B" on the controller.


Last but not least, a sale is now running, and the Spring one is not far too...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/1a8395693e41e253e47a84e0e4c78bb9a4f15d78.jpg

notes.title: Bug fix: controller in Mental State panel
notes.notes: A small bug fix update: fixed a bug when opening the Mental State panel and then attempting to close it with "B" on the controller.

notes.title: First patch after release
notes.notes:
This patch fixes the following:
- Your team name was not saved - sorry for that!!!
- Labels for controller bumpers/triggers in the blockers' controls when switching in real-time ("B" on the controller) were swapped.
- If you quickly opened/closed the inventory you could break controller focus.

notes.title: Roller Drama release date: January 26th!! 2023!! :-)
notes.notes:
So it's official: Roller Drama will launch on Steam on January 26th, yes this month this year, 2023!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/b4e526fb8866111f1c9f965523f88317c73224a3.gif

The game runs on all operating systems, and it's great on the Steam Deck (@Valve's Steam Deck team, please give it a try!). And that is not all: we will also release a DLC soundtrack, composed, played and mixed by Francesco Arcuri, with 32 songs, here is a preview:

[previewyoutube=3PPVMk8_bq0;full][/previewyoutube]
